parsed_json.up: Select IC50 activities in nM against target CHEMBL203 (Epidermal growth factor receptor). Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then to assays on assay_id, then to target_dictionary on tid. Join compound_structures on molregno to enforce non-null canonical_smiles. Join docs on activities.doc_id to obtain pubmed_id or doi. Join compound_records on activities.record_id to retrieve compound_key. Filter target_type to 'SINGLE PROTEIN', target organism to 'Homo sapiens', and require at least one of pubmed_id or doi. Return DISTINCT rows for compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
